reserveReview.rationale: Retrieved 2026-10-20. Brale's management assertion signed October 2, 2026 reports USD 923,605 cash and cash equivalents and USD 64,451 U.S. government-backed debt at September 30, 2026, 11:50pm Eastern Time, against 988,057 USDGLO issued. The two reported categories sum to USD 988,056, one dollar below the stated reserve total of USD 988,057; the report does not explain that one-dollar discrepancy. Percentages are normalized to the sum of the category amounts and rounded to two decimals. This composition update does not independently establish a shortfall or validate the reported coverage assertion. The report expressly defines issued supply across Arbitrum, Base, Celo, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Stellar and VeChain and reserves in unencumbered accounts segregated from Brale's other accounts. It is an Assertion of Brale Management without an independent accountant opinion. Bank identities, underlying cash-equivalent and debt instruments, maturities, provider allocations and withdrawal terms remain undisclosed; no maturity, liquidity or custody-continuity credit is inferred.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Custody-scope correction observed 2026-10-09T10:36:33Z: the August 31 management assertion identifies Brale's unencumbered reserve accounts segregated from its other accounts, but does not identify reserve banks, instrument custodians, provider shares, insolvency treatment, non-reuse controls or successor-custody arrangements. The transparency archive and May 27 governing terms provide no whole-book provider proof. Brale's issuer licensing does not establish the regulation of every unnamed reserve custodian; the aggregate custodyModel is unknown. The existing compositionAsOf and report dates are unchanged.
